title: Nourishing Sweet Peruvian Shredded Beef Aji De Gallina
description: A comforting, sweet, and bouncy-textured twist on classic Peruvian aji de gallina using tender shredded leftover beef, thick gelatinous bone broth, and pan-fried ripe sweet plantains. Perfect as a restorative sick-day meal, this recipe is naturally sweetened and keto-friendly without any added refined sugars.

ingredients.name: shredded cooked beef
ingredients.notes: using leftover roast beef or brisket

ingredients.name: unflavored gelatin powder
ingredients.notes: bloomed in two tablespoons of cold water for a bouncy QQ texture

ingredients.name: heavy cream
ingredients.notes: or coconut cream for a dairy-free option

instructions: Heat one tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet and fry the sliced ripe plantains until sweet, golden, and caramelized, then set them aside.
In a medium saucepan, heat the remaining olive oil over medium heat and saute the minced onion and garlic paste until soft and translucent.
Stir in the yellow aji amarillo paste and cook for two minutes until fragrant.
Pour in the beef bone broth and heavy cream, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Stir the bloomed gelatin into the hot liquid until completely dissolved to create a thick, silky, and bouncy sauce texture.
Add the shredded beef and simmer for five minutes until the meat is thoroughly heated and saturated with the creamy yellow sauce.
Season the mixture with a pinch of salt to taste, balancing the natural sweetness of the caramelized plantains.
Serve the warm shredded beef mixture over steamed rice or cauliflower rice, topped with the fried sweet plantains.
